messages:
maria: Hey runtime — seeing intermittent partial frames for a customer (conn_id=conn_3fa9). Client reports truncated responses and occasional clean disconnects. Where's the canonical place to pull raw WS frames, per-chunk timings, and traces for a single connection? Need to correlate with LB disconnects for a postmortem.

devon: Logs -> Datadog logs, filter: service:runtime env:prod ws_connection_id:conn_3fa9. We have a saved view 'streaming-per-conn' (link below). For traces: Honeycomb dataset 'runtime-traces' — you can look up by request_id or trace_id. Also grab LB/nginx access logs for the same time window.

sam: For chunk timing panels use the Grafana dashboard "Streaming — frames" -> panel "chunk_timing.by_conn". Quick metric to check: `streaming_chunk_duration_seconds_bucket` grouped by ws_connection_id.

tracebot: If you have x-request-id from the client header, you can map to trace id with the internal lookup. Example:
```bash
curl -sS "https://trace-api.redwood.internal/lookup?request_id=abc-789" | jq -r .trace_id
```

anna: Also check `streaming_heartbeat_misses` and `kv_cache_miss_rate` for the host that served the conn — partial frames often line up with KV thrash or instance preemption. Check node_cpu_steal and nvidia_smi memory spikes in the same window.

maria: thanks — I have x-request-id=abc-789. Will run the lookup. Does anyone have the quick dashboard links?

devon: Quick links:
- Datadog logs saved view: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Aruntime%20ws_connection_id%3Aconn_3fa9 (replace conn id)
- Grafana conn inspector: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/streaming/conn-inspect?var-conn=conn_3fa9
- Honeycomb traces: https://ui.honeycomb.io/redwood/datasets/runtime-traces/trace?trace_id={TRACE_ID}

sam: If you paste the trace id here I can pull the full flamegraph and span timeline. If it's partial frames, try repro with `envoy` debug enabled for the client route to capture raw frames.

infra-bot: Proposed alert tweak: lower `partial_frame_rate` threshold to 0.5% over 5m for prod and create a warning at 0.2% to reduce noise. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 (assigning to @sam for review).

maria: assigning follow-up to sam. I'll post trace id after the lookup. Appreciate the quick pointers :thumbsup:

sam: on it — will try to pull LB logs + machine metrics once you paste trace id.

maria: update: lookup returned trace_id=tr_0f9d2. Posting it now for anyone who wants to join the deep-dive.

devon: grabbed trace tr_0f9d2 — spans show two short SIGPIPE-like disconnects right after a KV fetch. Starting a small repro run on a dev node now.

anna: noted — I'll cross-check GPU memory and pod restarts in that time window.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll collect findings and open a short postmortem if we confirm a causal link.
